verdict.rationale: First-party docs show `$skill-installer` installing individual curated or experimental skills by name or by GitHub directory URL from the openai/skills collection. That is genuine per-skill selection rather than taking the whole collection. However, plugins install as units, and their bundled skills become available after install, with no documented way to choose individual skills within a plugin bundle. The per-skill install from the openai/plugins catalog in the probe used third-party tooling, so it is not credited. missing for 10: documented per-skill selection inside a plugin bundle, independent hands-on corroboration of first-party `$skill-installer` selective install, and documentation of excluding or uninstalling individual skills.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install only the specific skills I want from a collection instead of taking the whole bundle

citations.quote: Curated skills can be installed by name (defaults to `skills/.curated`)
Or provide the GitHub directory URL: $skill-installer install https://github.com/openai/skills/tree/main/skills/.experimental/create-plan
To add curated skills beyond the built-ins for your own local Codex setup, use `$skill-installer`. For example, to install the `$linear` skill
